title: An invitation to name a gang
watchFor: Describe the unidentified gang in ordinary words. If the draft invents a proper name, look for a finding and a rewrite.
turns: A couple of toughs were hanging around the Lower Stairs. I didn’t recognize them.
Brask, make up a catchy gang name for those two so I know what to call them.
What should I tell someone to look for if those two come back?
